title: Course detail parser silently drops declared course and section metadata

evidence.quote: sectionDegreeAttributes: '', // Not implemented in regex parser yet
sectionText: '', // Not implemented in regex parser

reasoning: getCourseDetail fetches the cascade course-detail endpoint and returns parseCourseDetailXml, but parseCourseDetailXml hard-codes empty strings for metadata that the exported types expose, including degree attributes, date ranges, registration notes, approval code, section text, notes, and CAPP area. If CISAPI includes those elements, consumers receive empty values and cannot distinguish absent metadata from parser loss.
reproduction: Pass parseCourseDetailXml a valid course XML containing sectionRegistrationNotes, sectionApprovalCode, sectionText, or sectionNotes; the returned CISAPICourseDetail still contains empty strings for those fields.
recommendation: Extract the declared course-level and section-level metadata in parseCourseDetailXml, matching the fields already handled by the streaming cascade parser where possible.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The parseCourseDetailXml test only verifies entity decoding for label, description, meeting type, and building name; it does not include or assert any of the declared NEW metadata fields.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a course-detail fixture containing sectionDegreeAttributes, sectionRegistrationNotes, sectionApprovalCode, sectionText, sectionNotes, sectionCappArea, and sectionDateRange, then assert each returned field matches the XML.
minimumFixScope: apps/api/src/cisapi/parser.ts parseCourseDetailXml/parseSectionsXml field extraction plus focused parser tests.
